notes:
Hosting works again.

Hosting had been failing with "Unable to find ProcessEventAddress aborting..". The game server looks for a particular piece of the engine by scanning memory for it, and that search was unreliable on 7.40 — the same build found it three times in a row one minute and came up empty the next, and a miss stops hosting dead.

Cobalt, which is already running inside the same game, finds that same piece every single time and then uses it thousands of times over, so it is known to be right. It now hands the answer to the game server, which uses it whenever its own search comes up empty. The address is checked before it is used, so a bad one is ignored rather than trusted.

This release also tidies up the version numbering. 1.8.7 and 1.8.8 were withdrawn, so this is the first release after 1.8.6 — installing it will bring you up to date from any of them.
